description: This file defines a PHP class ContactsViewCloseContactAddressPopup, which extends ViewList, and includes a display method that may close the browser window if a specific request parameter is set. It appears to be a web view component for handling contact address popup closure within CRM software.

classes.name: ContactsViewCloseContactAddressPopup
classes.description: A view class for closing a contact address popup window in the CRM application.

methods.name: CloseContactAddressPopup
methods.description: The constructor method for the contact address popup view class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to optionally close the browser window if 'close_window' is set in the request.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic, closing the window if requested, then calls parent display.
